## Our benefits and perks

![Kojo benefits and perks](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/62729c594454f55c901fb1f2/66954383730e96853c5b0d37_All-hands%20.avif)

[**Comprehensive benefits**](https://www.usekojo.com/careers#)

PPO and HSA medical plans, dental and vision plans, fully-covered disability and life insurance coverage.

[**Remote-first workforce**](https://www.usekojo.com/careers#)

Allows our team to work from anywhere in the US or abroad while on a travel visa.

[**Flexible PTO**](https://www.usekojo.com/careers#)

Plus ten paid holidays that allow flexibility to heal, recharge, travel, or celebrate.

[**Paid parental leave**](https://www.usekojo.com/careers#)

Guarantees 100% salary for up to 12 weeks for a birthing parent and up to 4 weeks for a non-birthing parent.

[**A culture of community**](https://www.usekojo.com/careers#)

Team building, birthday celebrations, virtual crossword puzzles and demo hours, Lunch & Learns, in-person hub hangouts, and company wide offsite retreats.

[**Other perks**](https://www.usekojo.com/careers#)

Including equipment for your home office, professional development and wellness programs, and recurring stipend to support the remote work experience.
